snippet.title: ToneTrek – Free Puzzle Demo Now Available on Steam! Try 20 Logic Levels
snippet.description:
🆓 Try ToneTrek for FREE!
🧩 20 mind-bending color puzzles — now available in two ways:

🌐 Play instantly in your browser:
https://darkwatersgames.com/tonetrek

🖥 Download the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851630/ToneTrek

💡 No save/load or controller support yet, but all tile styles and color schemes are included!
🎯 Perfect for puzzle lovers — whether you're on desktop or mobile.
💬 Let us know what you think & don't forget to wishlist the full game!

🕹️ Demo Features:
– 20 unique color-based puzzle levels
– Beautiful, customizable color schemes
– Keyboard and mouse controls
– Limited functionality (no save/load, no controller support – yet!)

🎯 Your goal: recreate the target image by walking across tiles to change their color – in the fewest moves possible!

💡 Full version coming soon with campaign mode, more levels, controller support, save/load, and more!

📣 Follow us for updates and the full launch:
🌐 Website: https://darkwatersgames.com/tonetrek
📘 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61564462991559
📺 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@dark_waters_games

🔖 Don’t forget to wishlist ToneTrek to support the game and stay tuned!

🧠 #ToneTrek #SteamDemo #PuzzleGame #IndieDev #ColorLogic #FreeGame
